scripts.check: npm run check:reproduce && npm run check:registry && npm run check:reference && npm run check:desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:reference && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:quickgui: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && quickgui test
scripts.smoke: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && tsx scripts/render-demo.ts
scripts.build:native: npm run check:architecture && napi build --manifest-path crates/picsie-native/Cargo.toml --package picsie-native --output-dir native --dts ../src/engine/native-api.d.ts --release && cargo run --quiet -p picsie-core --bin export_types && oxfmt --write src/engine/types.ts src/engine/native-api.d.ts
scripts.check:desktop: npm run check:architecture && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/picsie-desktop/Cargo.toml --check && cargo check --locked --manifest-path crates/picsie-desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:desktop: npm run check:architecture && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/picsie-desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev:quickgui: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && quickgui dev
scripts.build:quickgui: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && node scripts/patch-quickgui-nsis.mjs && quickgui build
scripts.check:reference: npm run check:architecture && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo check --workspace && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:reference: npm run check:architecture && npm run build:native && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:reproduce && cargo test -p picsie-core && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
